headline: Free rhymes today + Heritage Week Saturday
summary: Walsall Summer Tots and Solihull Core Rhymetime today; free library rhymes Thu–Fri; free Heritage for All drop-in Sat at The Exchange.

notices.title: Weather (Met Office Birmingham)
notices.detail: Wed 9 sunny intervals ~17°C with a few light-shower chances (esp morning/early afternoon). Thu 10 fine/sunny start ~19°C then rain/breezier from late afternoon/evening. Fri 11 brighter with sunny intervals ~20°C after damp overnight start. Sat 12 sunny intervals ~21°C, rain chance rises ~30–40% from midday/afternoon. Sun 13 brighter after early damp ~20°C. Outdoor plans viable with a light layer; watch Thu evening and Sat mid-afternoon.

datedPicks.title: Summer Tots at Lichfield Street Hub
datedPicks.location: Lichfield Street Hub (Walsall Central Library), Lichfield Street, Walsall WS1 1TR
datedPicks.description: Stories, rhymes and play for children aged 0–5 at Walsall’s central library hub. Weekly Wednesday session with places limited.
datedPicks.appeal: Stories, rhymes and play at Walsall central library hub; useful for younger children who need an easy morning plan.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: children aged 0-5. DoNext fit: preschoolers and early primary siblings with an adult.
datedPicks.parentTip: Contact Lichfield Street Hub to reserve (places limited). Email LSHlibrary@walsall.gov.uk or call 01922 653 121.

datedPicks.title: Meet and Play at The Core Library
datedPicks.location: The Core Library, Homer Road, Solihull B91 3RG

datedPicks.title: Heritage for All at The Exchange (+ Barber family workshop)
datedPicks.location: The Exchange, 3 Centenary Square, Birmingham B1 2DR
datedPicks.description: Free Birmingham Heritage Week drop-in: vaults exhibition, building tours, family heritage trail, and Barber Institute “Reimagine the Archive” family art workshop (ideal ages 4–10). Café open.
datedPicks.appeal: A free city-centre heritage day with building tours, a family trail and a Barber family art workshop.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: families; linked Barber workshop is ideal for ages 4-10. DoNext fit: ages 4-12, with younger children along.
datedPicks.parentTip: Part of Birmingham Heritage Week (11–20 Sep). No booking. Step-free access + Changing Places toilet.

datedPicks.title: Board Games at Bloxwich Community Library
datedPicks.location: Bloxwich Community Library, High Street, Bloxwich WS3 2DA
datedPicks.description: Free Saturday board-games hour for children and families at Bloxwich Community Library.
datedPicks.appeal: A free family board-games hour for a low-effort Saturday indoor plan.

datedPicks.parentTip: Family-friendly games hour — good indoor backup if rain builds Sat afternoon.

datedPicks.title: Morning Explorers at Thinktank (autism-friendly)
datedPicks.cost: Admission charges apply (Members free entry but must pre-book; optional planetarium extra)
datedPicks.description: Second-Saturday autism-friendly morning: early entry from 9am, quieter galleries (sounds muted to 11am), ear defenders/sensory maps. Suitable for autistic children and accompanying family. MiniBrum/science garden from 9.30am.
datedPicks.statusNote: Labelled Thinktank backup — not a free shortlist hero.
datedPicks.appeal: A quieter autism-friendly museum morning with early entry, muted sounds, sensory maps and ear defenders.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: autistic children and accompanying family. DoNext fit: any age that benefits from a lower-sensory museum slot.
datedPicks.parentTip: Tourist-staple venue — listed as labelled accessibility backup only. Paid admission; book ahead.
